name: Concepción Alegre — birth, marriage and parents (Paraguay)
researcher_question: When and where was Concepción Alegre of Altos, Cordillera, Paraguay born, who were her parents, and when did she marry Vicente Figueredo?
notes: Record-hint fixture (filtered-list-samples.csv row 25, flags adds_father/adds_mother/adds_birth/adds_marriage, confidence 3). Adjudicated 2026-08-12 (issue #875): the hinted marriage is correct, but its indexed parent names are the marriage witnesses, promoted into the bride's parent fields in error. Birth and marriage are kept; the indexed parents are encoded as a polarity:avoid guard; the real parents (Venancio Alegre, María de la Paz Resquín) are recoverable only from the register page, not the index.
